Commentary.Commentary: Australia, on the other hand, started well with the bat. Finch and Warner provided them a decent start. Smith then steadied the ship in the middle overs but once he got out, they lost the plot. The Aussies kept losing wickets at regular intervals and were not able to score with freedom. Head, however, fought a lone battle and played a gem of an innings towards the end. The World Champions would be disappointed as they would have wanted a lot more on board but would look to make up for it with the ball. Join us in a while for the chase.

Travis Head's superb knock in the end helped Australia post a fighting total. Though England will be very happy to restrict their opposition here. They bowled brilliantly in the middle overs. The fast bowlers varied their lengths and used the cross-seam balls to good effect. Adil Rashid and Mark Wood both picked 4 wickets each. The former ran through the batting line up in the back end of the innings while the latter provided them with crucial breakthroughs.
Slower ball, Head drags his pull on the leg side. Sloppy effort from the fielder there sees Head come back for two. AUSTRALIA END ON 277/9.
Short ball wide outside off, Head slaps it but straight to long off. They opt not to run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to long off.
FOUR! EDGY! Bowls a fuller length outside off, Head slashes hard at it but gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies past the keeper for a boundary. 10 off the first 3 balls.

DROPPED! Full outside off, Head tries to heave it but mistimes it straight up in the air. Plunkett who is late to react comes running in from long off, gets two hands to it but drops it. That's second drop by him. Head wants to keep the strike so doesn't run.

SIX! THAT IS HUGE! Stokes bowls it a tad fuller on the stumps. Head flicks it over the mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep, jumps and tries to catch it but the ball goes over him for a maximum. Good start to the over, this!
Bowls it full on the stumps, Head works it on the leg side for a run.
SMART BOWLING! Head comes down the track, Ball sees him and bowls a very slow bouncer. Head tries to put bat on it but misses it.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
SIX! BANG! That's going, going and gone. That was hit to the bigger part of the ground. Short ball and Head pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.

JUST SHORT! Good effort there from Wood. Ball bowls it a tad fuller on off. Head goes for the big one but gets a top edge which flies down to third man. Wood comes running in, puts in a dive but the ball falls just short. He, however, does well to stop the ball and the batsmen don't run.
Length ball angling across, Head goes for a heave but misses it.
Jake Ball comes back into the attack.
Full on the pads, Head flicks it through square leg for a single. He will keep the strike.
Full and outside off, Head swings but does not get bat to it.
Back of a length outside off, Hazlewood cuts it through point for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball on the stumps, Hazlewood defends it off the front foot.
Stokes bowls it on a length, Head walks down the track and tries to heave it over mid-wicket but only gets it off the toe end of the bat to covers. They run through for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off, the batsman attempts to put bat on it but fails and the umpire signals a wide.
Ben Stokes is brought back into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length, Hazlewood looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Josh Hazlewood comes into bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Wood has his best figures in the ODIs. He bowls a fast full toss on off stump. Zampa moves his front leg out of the way and tries to put bat on ball but misses and gets knocked over. You miss, I hit stuff there from the English pacer! Australia lose their 9th wicket with only 254 on the board.
Back of a length ball, comes in a touch. Zampa defends off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
6th ODI fifty for Travis Head.
Short ball on the stumps, Head pulls it on the leg side for a run.
Adam Zampa comes out to bat.

OUT! RASHID GETS A 4-FER! Australia are gifting wickets to Rashid. He tosses it up on off, Cummins chips it off the outer half back to the bowler and the leggie takes another caught and bowled. Adil Rashid has finished his spell with excellent figures of 10-1-41-4. He has been the game changer for England today.
Tosses it up on off, Cummins leans forward and goes for the drive but the ball turns and beats the outside edge.
Bowls a googly outside off, the ball keeps a little low. Cummins gets his bat down at the right time and that saves him.
Floats it on off, Cummins goes down on one knee and paddle sweeps it for a couple.
Drags his length back outside off, Head punches it through covers for a run.
Flighted on the stumps, Cummins works it to mid on for a run.
Length ball outside off, Cummins guides it down to third man for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Head works it through square leg for a run.
Very full on the leg stump, Head drives it straight back to the bowler.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Bowls it on a length, hurries onto Cummins, who misses the ball and hits him high on his thigh pad and they run through for a leg bye.
Bowls in short on the stumps, Head pulls it on the leg side for a run.
Pat Cummins comes out to bat.

OUT! There goes another one! Second in the over for Rashid. This is not one of his best deliveries that he has bowled today. It's a full toss on leg stump which Starc tries to sweep but gets a top edge. Root at first slip takes a couple of steps to his right and pouches it with ease. Australia are falling like a pack of cards!
Full ball on off, Starc drives it to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mitchell Starc comes out to bat.

OUT! SOFT DISMISSAL! Bowls a wrong one outside off, Wade shuffles across and tries to flick it through the leg side but gets a top edge. Rashid takes an easy catch off his own bowling. Australia are losing their way now. Rashid gets his second of the game.
Head drives it through mid off for a run.
Tosses it outside off, Head drives it uppishly through mid off for a couple.
Wade works it through to mid-wicket. They run one, Moeen Ali fumbles there and they run through for a second.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it on the leg stump, Head flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Mathew Wade is the next man in.

OUT! Amazing catch from Jason Roy! So, the dropped chance has not cost England a lot. Maxwell is heading back to the hut. Wood bowls it short on the stumps, Maxwell goes for the pull and connects well. Roy at deep mid-wicket leaps and hangs on to it. But, he seems to be going over the fence and so throws the ball up in the air and then comes in from the boundary to complete the catch. Superb athleticism by Roy. They go up to check whether he has taken it cleanly and after quite a few replays the third umpire gives it out. This is a superb break for England as Maxwell can be very lethal at the fag end.
The umpires have gone upstairs to check whether Roy took a clean catch in the deep. The soft signal is out.
Wood bowls it wide and full, Maxwell makes room and tries to put bat on it but misses.

NOT OUT! Wood bowls it back a length outside off, Maxwell moves his front leg out of the way and hits it hard to covers. Plunkett there, gets both his hands to it but the ball pops out and hits his chest and goes onto the ground. There is a chance of a run out at the non-striker's end and Liam is alert. He scores a direct hit. The umpires go upstairs to check but the replays suggest the batsman was well in. Eventful delivery, a dropped catch and an attempted run out.
The umpire has gone upstairs to have a look as Plunkett after dropping the catch has scored a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Mark Wood comes back into the attack.
Short outside off, Head cuts it behind point for a couple.
Tosses it up on middle, Maxwell flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Drags his length back, Head pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowled on the stumps, Head flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Bowls the googly outside off, Head tries to cut but gets beaten.
Starts off with a full toss outside off, Head drives it hard but straight to Morgan at covers, who misfields and concedes two.
Adil Rashid is brought back into the attack.
Bowls it on the stumps, Head works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, Head pushes it to cover.
FOUR! TENNIS SHOT! Ball again bangs in short, Head makes room and slaps it through mid on for a boundary. The Aussies are getting a move on here.
FOUR! IN THE GAP! Short ball on the stumps, Head pulls it between mid-wicket and square leg for a boundary.
Bowls it outside off, Maxwell tries to guide it down to third man but gets an under edge and the ball rolls in the vacant slip cordon. They run a single.
Angles it into the pads, Head attempts the flick but misses it. The ball brushes his pads and rolls on the leg side. They run through for a leg bye.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now five fielders can be placed outside the circle.
Full outside off, Maxwell drives it hard in the cover region but finds the fielder again.
Wide! Maxwell gets across, Moeen slides it down leg. The Aussie smartly lets it go.
Another delivery, slightly on the shorter side. Maxwell looks to thump it straight down but once again fails to get hold of it. Mistimes it over mid on for a brace.
Sliding into Maxwell, who looks to go big on the leg side but mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time Maxwell connects! Flatter delivery, sliding in, Maxwell makes room and punches it with all his might through covers for a boundary.
Full in line of the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Spinning in from around off, Maxwell makes room. Goes hard at it but ends up slicing it through backward point for a single.
The floodlights have been turned on as it has gone a little darker.
Maxwell glides it to third man for a single.
Short, angling away, bounces a touch extra as well. Head stays tall and dabs it in front of covers for a single.
Full around pads, clipped through backward square leg for a couple.
Angling down leg, tickled fine down for a single.
A touch behind length outside off, Maxwell has a big go at it but misses it completely.
Leg bye! Length delivery, jags back in. Head gets on his toes and looks to play it across the line but misses and gets it off the pads on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Flatter delivery, spinning away, punched through covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Flatter delivery outside off, Maxwell camps back and punches it solidly through covers for a boundary.
Served in the line of the stumps, Maxwell looks to reverse sweep but gets a bottom edge into the pads. Had he missed, he would have been adjudged lbw.
Spinning away from Head, guided past slip for a run.
Floated outside off, Maxwell uses his feet and drives it hard to the left of mid off. Hales there, does extremely well to dive to his left and make a superb stop. A single is taken.
Shortish delivery, dabbed on the leg side for a single.
Angling into Maxwell, driven with the angle to mid on.
Straying on the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery around leg, punched to mid on.
Slightly shorter, pulled nicely through mid-wicket for a brace.

Leg bye! Served slightly behind length around off. The ball nips back in after pitching and gets the better of Maxwell's defence. The ball lobs off the thigh pad behind square on the off side and a leg bye is taken.
Jake Ball is back on.
Flatter around off, Maxwell makes room and punches it through covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

JUST SHORT! Shortish delivery, sliding across, Head slashes at it but ends up slicing it in the backward point region. Luckily, it falls short of Ball there, who circles after it as the ball spins away. Seeing that, Maxwell from the other end takes off but Head is ball-watching and so Maxwell has to make his way back. Ball throws at the bowler's end but by that time Maxwell is in.
Another full delivery is driven back to the bowler.
Full around off, driven back to the bowler.
Leg bye! Spinning down leg, Maxwell fails to clip it and the ball goes off the pads on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.

FOUR! EDGED BUT JUST WIDE! On a length and angling away, nips away slightly. Head looks to punch it across the line but gets an outside edge and the ball flies past the diving Root, who is at widish first slip. The ball races to the fence. Wood nearly had his third.
Slightly fuller again outside off, Maxwell carves it through covers for a single.
Fuller length delivery outside off, driven off the middle but straight to mid off.
Another one on a good length outside off, Head punches it wide of mid off and takes off for a quick single. There's a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Slightly back of a length outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, punched on the off side.
Time for a drinks break!
Served outside off, Maxwell gets across and turns it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wide! Down the leg side, Maxwell misses his flick and a wide is signalled.
Flatter delivery outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Head drives it to covers again.
Off spinner outside off, pushed to covers.
Full around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Wicket-maiden from Mark Wood! This over could very well be the difference in Australia's end total.
Pitched wide outside off, Maxwell with a huge stride ahead leaves it.
Banged in short, Maxwell ducks under it and lets it sail through to the keeper.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery, angling in. Maxwell looks to defend on the leg side but gets squared up and the leading edge goes to point.
Glenn Maxwell walks out in the middle.

OUT! BIG, BIG BLOW! Bowling change works for England! Fuller length delivery outside off, Smith looks to drive it on the up with a straight bat. However, he is slightly early into the shot and ends up checking his shot straight to Plunkett at mid off. The English quickie takes a good low catch. This is a huge blow for Australia. The skipper is livid with himself. England have started picking up regular wickets now.
Mark Wood comes back, replacing Plunkett.
Served in the line of the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Ali slides it in, Head with a huge stride forward drives it to long off for a single.
Smith plays with the spin through the leg side for a single.
Full around off, driven back to the bowler again.
Another flatter delivery, punched back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery outside off, defended on the off side.
Moeen Ali replaces Rashid.
Short and angling down leg, pulled with ease behind square on the leg side for a single.
Slightly ahead of length outside off, driven on the up straight to extra cover.
Pitched outside off, punched on the off side.
17th ODI fifty for Steven Smith.

FOUR! What a way to bring up the half century! Full outside off, Smith leans into the shot and drives it crisply through widish mid off. Rashid can't cut it off and the Aussie skipper collects another boundary. Mind you, he is yet to get out in this tournament!
Short and angling away, Head pulls it into the ground through square leg for a single.
On a length and angling away, driven on the up to mid on.
Bowls a googly but fuller in length, Head drives it straight down the ground where Plunkett makes a good stop and only concedes a run.
Flatter ball on off, Smith punches it to long off for a run.
Drags his length back, Smith cuts it but straight to backward point.
Bowls it full, Smith defends it off the front foot.
Bowls a leg spinner on the middle, Smith defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length outside off, Head punches it through covers for a couple.
Bowls it on a length, Plunkett gets some extra bounce. Head tries to defend it off the front foot but gets hit on the glove and the ball rolls to the slip region.
FOUR! POOR LENGTH! Short and width on offer, Head rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
A tad short on off, Head defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, Smith plays it through the point region for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bowls a leg spinner on the pads, Smith flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Head plays it through mid-wicket for a run.
Travis Head strides out to the middle.

OUT! Good fielding change there by Morgan. He just brings the long on inside the circle and Henriques falls for it. Rashid tosses it up outside off, Henriques tries to drag it over mid on but hits it straight to Plunkett who takes a good low catch. England are fighting their way back into the match.
Pushed it through on the stumps, Henriques plays it off the back foot.
Bowls it on the pads, Smith flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Flights it on the stumps, Smith plays it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full ball outside off, Henriques leans into the drive and hits it to through covers for a boundary.
Length ball on the stumps, Smith works it on the leg side for a run.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Henriques guides it down to third man for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball on off, Smith defends it off the back foot.
Liam Plunkett is brought back into the attack.
Comes down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
Floats it on off, Henriques drives it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball on the stumps, Smith punches it to long on for a run.
Henriques plays a paddle sweep down to fine leg for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Henriques drives it beautifully through covers for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease
Length ball outside off, jags in a little. Smith tries to defend off the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads and it rolls through to the keeper. Good ball to end the over.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off and the umpire calls a wide.
Bowls it down the leg side, the batsman tries to flick but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls down to fine leg. They run through for a leg bye.
FOUR! POOR LENGTH! Short ball on the stumps, Henriques pulls it behind square leg for another boundary. That's back-to-back boundaries for him.
FOUR! SUPERB! Full ball outside off, Henriques just times it through cover-point for a boundary. He gets off the mark.
Length ball on off, Henriques defends it off the front foot.
Bowled on off, Smith flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Henriques drives it to covers. A maiden by Rashid.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Drags his length back a little, the batsman cuts it to short third man.
Bowls a googly, Henriques reads it and defends it off the front foot.
Bowled on the stumps, Henriques defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Moises Henriques comes out to bat.

OUT! GONE! That was needless from Finch. He was playing so well. Stokes bowls it full on off, Finch tries to loft it over mid off but hits it straight up in the air. Morgan at extra cover runs back a little, seems to have misjudged it in the beginning but circles under it to take a good catch. England needed that wicket desperately and Stokes provides it. Can they build on this wicket?
Bowls it on a length on off, Smith walks across and flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Length ball on the stumps, Finch tucks it through backward square leg for a run.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! WOW! That was hit with a lot of power. Full ball on off, Finch drives it down the ground past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Short ball on the stumps, Smith pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Smith comes down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Finch punches it on the long off for a run.
Finch picks the wrong one on the stumps and pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
HUGE APPEAL! Bowls it flatter and it slides on, Finch goes back to flick but misses it and is struck on the pads. England appeal but the umpire is not interested. Might be missing leg.
Bowls a leg spinner on the stumps, Finch goes down on one knee and paddles it for a couple.
Tosses it on leg stump, Smith drives it to mid on for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Smith walks across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off, Smith tries to get bat on it but misses and it is called a wide. Stokes looks a little surprised but it was just on the line.
Hurls it on a length, Smith defends it from within the crease.
Length ball on off, Stokes defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Smith won't miss out on that one. It's a full toss outside off, the Aussie skipper square drives it through the gap for a boundary. Easy pickings for him.
A tad fuller outside off, Smith shuffles across and lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Finch cuts it through cover-point for a run.
Change of ends for Ben Stokes. A short mid on is place now.
This time Finch picks the googly early and punches it through wide mid on for a single.

THAT KEPT VERY LOW! Another wrong 'un from Rashid on the shorter side. Finch goes back to punch it on the leg side but the ball keeps low and catches his pads. A muted appeal for lbw but this one was surely going down leg.

HUGE, HUGE SHOUT FOR LBW! But, it's turned down again. Rashid shouts his heart out for that. Another googly from the leggie. Finch once again fails to read it, prods forward to defend with bat and pad close. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal loudly. The umpire, however, stays put. After a long discussion with his keeper and bowler, Morgan doesn't take the review. The Hot Spot shows that there might have been an inside edge but it's not clear of what. The Hawk Eye though detects that the impact was in line and that the ball would have gone on to hit the stumps.

SHOUT FOR LBW! Wrong one from Rashid. Finch prods forward to defend but plays down the wrong line as he fails to pick the variation. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. However, it's turned down. Going down leg, maybe.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, Smith milks it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, eased on to long off for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Smith shuffles again and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! SUPERB! Ahead of length around off, angling in, Smith shimmies a touch and drives it crisply past mid on for a boundary. He is slowly getting into his groove now!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Straying on the pads, Finch flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Short and angling down leg, Smith fails to get hold of this. Mistimes his pull to fine leg for one.
Free Hit coming up!

NO BALL! BEAMER! The ball slips from Plunkett's hand and it's a chest-high full toss outside off, Smith gets across and places it in the backward square leg region. Some good running earns him a brace.
Rashid drags his length back, Smith punches it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Leg spinner outside leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Served full in the line of the stumps, driven past mid on. Ball from long off, hares to his right and dives to make a good stop. Saves a couple of runs for his side.
Leg break on off, Smith watches it carefully and defends it on the off side.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Time for spin as Adil Rashid is brought on. A slip in place for him!

Drinks break! After losing Warner early, Australia have done well to steady the ship. Steven Smith is playing second fiddle to Aaron Finch, who has looked extremely solid. He is playing a superb knock and his stay will be very crucial for Australia. England need to strike and break this partnership.
Smith shimmies a touch and flicks it in front of square for an easy single.
Length delivery outside off, blocked on the off side.
Pitched outside off, pushed off the inner half to mid on.
16th ODI fifty for Aaron Finch!

Fuller length delivery, angling in, Finch clips it through mid-wicket for a single. Gets to his fifty with this. What a knock it has been from the Aussie opener. Very sublime! He continues his good form against England. His 4th 50-plus score against them in the last 5 innings.
Smith walks across and tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slightly back of a length, the ball takes off a touch after pitching. Finch is surprised by the extra bounce and blocks it off the splice.
50-run stand is up between Finch and Smith!
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Smith defends with soft hands on the leg side and takes off for a quick single.

FOUR! STREAKY! Fuller length delivery outside off, Smith gets across, looks to drive it on the off side but gets an outside edge. Buttler dives full stretch to his right but can't get his hand to it. The ball then races away to the fence behind.
Outside off, glided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Back of a length outside off, Finch gets on his toes and cuts it past backward point for another boundary.
FOUR! In the gap! Short and angling in, Finch pulls it with utter ease behind square on the leg side for a boundary. He moves to 44!
Angling into the batsman, straightens a touch. Smith looks to play it across the line but gets a leading edge towards backward point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Angling into Smith, he blocks it down the wicket.
Outside off, left alone.
Full around off, Smith stays in the crease and keeps it out on the off side.
Wide outside off, Finch slashes it hard through covers for a single.
Outside off, Finch punches it with ease through covers for a single.
Short and angling in, Smith gets across, pulls cleanly through mid-wicket. There's protection out there and so just a single is taken.
On a length outside off, Smith gets across and punches it to covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch gets on his toes, dabs it in the vacant cover region for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch plays a punchy drive to covers.
Full on middle, driven to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angling into Smith, he gets across and drives to mid on.
Leg bye! Straying on the pads, Finch once again fails to flick it. The ball brushes his thigh pad and runs to fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
WIDE! Angling down leg, Finch misses his flick and a wide is called.

HESITATION IN BETWEEN! On a length and angling in, Finch defends it with soft hands to mid on, takes a couple of steps ahead. Smith also takes off for a single but is sent back at the right time by the opener, seeing Stokes charge to the ball. The Aussie skipper turns back and gets to his crease in time. Also to his luck, Stokes there failed to get rid of the ball cleanly. No harm done!
Length delivery around off, Finch stays back and with the straight bat defends to mid on.
Full and angling in, driven with the angle to mid on.
Short and angling in, Finch is slightly early into his shot and mistimes his pull in the backward square leg region for a single.
Smith shuffles across and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, Smith drives it crisply but straight to short cover.
Length delivery, angling in, Finch shimmies just a touch and tucks it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Another solid punch from Finch but straight to mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched to covers.
Ben Stokes is into the attack now!
Angling into Finch, he gets on his toes and works it gently on the leg side for a single.
Pitched outside off, Finch punches it on the up and the ball goes on the bounce to mid off.
FOUR! GLORIOUS! Full and angling in, once again Finch drives it with a straight bat. This time through mid on for another boundary. He is looking well-balanced out there!
Angling into Smith, he shimmies across and places it wide of mid on for a single.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Finch has looked really in a great touch this morning.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Full around off, Finch leans into the shot and drives it through the line, past the stumps at the other end. The mid off fielder can't cut it off and the ball races to the fence.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Liam Plunkett is introduced into the attack.
Lands it on a length outside off, Smith leaves it through to the keeper.
Bowls it full on off, Smith drives it to mid off.
Back of a length ball on off, Smith punches it to mid off.
Bowls it on the stumps, Finch flicks it through square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Finch leaves it through to the keeper.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bowls it full on the stumps, Smith drives it straight down the ground where Plunkett dives to his right at mid off. He gets a hand to it and takes the pace off the ball. The batsman run two.
FOUR! LOVELY TIMING! Full ball on off, Smith leans into the drive and times it through covers for a boundary.
Bowls it outside off, Smith lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on off, Finch punches it through cover-point for a triple.
Bowled on the pads, Smith flicks it through square leg for a run.

BIG APPEAL! Length ball outside off, jags bag in a little. Smith shuffles across and chooses to leave the ball but is struck on the pads. They all appeal but the umpire gives it not out. England opt not to review. The replays show it was high.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Strays down the leg side, Finch flicks it fine and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Back of a length, Smith defends it towards covers where Morgan misfields and they run through for a single. Smith gets off the mark.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Smith lets it go through to the keeper.
BEATEN! A good delivery to get first up. Length ball outside off, Smith pokes at it but gets beaten.
Steven Smith comes out to bat.

OUT! WOOD STRIKES! England get the wicket of Warner. Length ball angling away, Warner looks to flick it through the leg side but gets an outside edge straight to the keeper. Warner was looking at the pitch after he nicked it. Nevertheless, England have got a big breakthrough.
Back of a length on off, Finch looks to punch it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads and they run through for a single.
FOUR! A tad short on off, Warner pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. A good start for Australia.
JUST SHORT! Back of a length ball outside off, Warner punches it through covers where Morgan at cover dives to his left and the ball does not carry to him.
Bowls it on the pads, Finch tries to flick it but misses, the ball brushes his pads and rolls to fine leg. They run a leg bye.
A tad full on off, Finch tries to loft it over mid off but gets it off the toe end but enough to clear mid off and they run two.
Bowls it on the pads, Warner flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Lands it on a length, Warner defends it off the front foot.

Back of a length on off, Warner defends it off the back foot and sets off for a run but is sent back. Jason Roy from point scores a direct hit but Warner is safely back in. The ball deflects away and they run for an overthrow.
BEATEN! Fuller ball angling across, Warner pokes at it but gets beaten.
Length ball on the pads, Warner flicks it on the leg side.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Wood bowls it on the pads, Warner just tickles it fine and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Bowls it on the pads, Warner flicks it to mid-wicket.
Finch looks to pull but gets a bottom edge towards fine leg. They pick up a single.
Length ball, Finch plays it with soft hands on the off side and sets off for a single. Morgan has a shy at the non striker's end but misses.
Short ball on off, Warner tries to defend off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls to the right off the wicket and the batsmen run through for a single.
Bowls it on a back of a length, Warner defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Short of a length around off, Warner just pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Hurls it on a length on off, Finch tucks it to square leg for a run.
WIDE! Strays it down the leg side. Finch misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length on off, Warner tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bowls it on a shorter length on off, Finch plays it with soft hands on the off side and they scamper through for a run. Good running.
A tad short on the stumps, Finch defends it again.
Back of a length ball, Finch defends it off the back foot.
Short ball aimed at the body off the batsman. Warner pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
The ball has been changed as the previous ball lost its shape after Warner hit it for a boundary!
FOUR! SHOT! Back of a length ball on middle. Warner pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Warner plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run. 10 off the over.
Full ball on off, Warner drives it to mid off.
Length ball on the stumps, Finch tucks it on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Full ball on the stumps, Finch tries to clip it through mid-wicket but gets a thick inside edge and the ball goes through forward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, Finch defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! SMASHED! Length ball on off, Finch smashes it past mid on for a boundary. First boundary of the day for Australia.
Length ball on off, Warner defends it onto the ground. Just a run from the first two overs.
Full ball on the stumps, Finch tries to drive it straight but gets an outside edge through covers for a run.
Bowls it wide outside off, Finch slashes at it but gets beaten. Tentative start for Finch.
Lands it on a length outside off, Finch lets it go through to the keeper.
Offers some width, Finch goes after it but gets beaten.
Bowls it wide outside off, Finch tries to drive it through the off side but misses.
Mark Wood will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Length ball on off, Warner defends it off the front foot. Ball starts off with a maiden here. Good first over.
Back of a length on off, Warner defends it off the back foot.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Warner lets it go through to the keeper.
BEATEN! JAFFA! On a length outside off, the ball straightens after pitching. Warner pokes at it and gets beaten.
Full ball angles it into the pads, Warner flicks it to mid on.
Starts off on a length on off, Warner defends it off the back foot.

The Australian openers, David Warner and Aaron Finch have taken their place in the centre. They need to set up a good platform in this big game. Jake Ball with the first new ball in his hand. Two slips in place. He will be bowling around the wicket for the southpaw. Here we go...
The players are out for their respective national anthem.

Australia skipper, Steven Smith says that he would have batted first as it looks a good surface and they would want to post runs on board in a big match. Mentions that it was a tough decision between John Hastings and Adam Zampa but they have gone with the latter as the pitch looks slightly on the drier side and also as the leggie has been a wicket-taker for them. Praises England for their recent performances and says that his side will have to be at its best today to beat them. Adds that the weather hasn't been ideal but it's not in their hands.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says he will bowl first. Feels the wicket is good and also there is rain in the air so he doesn't know how much will it affect the game. Reckons it has always been a good ground with a lot of runs with short boundaries. He says they are playing an unchanged team. On asked whether he thought of dropping Jason Roy, he says that the opener is due some runs. Opines just because there is nothing to play for, does not mean they change around.
TOSS - Eoin Morgan flips the coin. 'Heads' is the call from Steven Smith but it's 'Tails'. ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD!

PITCH REPORT - Michael Atherton says it's a fresh strip. It's unused and pretty good. Not much grass on it but it's still pretty hard. Because of the overcast conditions, he feels the winning captain will opt to bowl. The spinners too might get some purchase as it's little bit dry.

The weather hasn't been kind to the World Champions so far and today also there has been forecast for rain. Their fans would be praying that the weather prediction doesn't come true and that they witness a full match.

England, on the other hand, have qualified through and would hope that Jason Roy, the only one to be out of form, finds his touch back as the pressure is off. The hosts are the favourites to win the tournament and have lived up to it as they are the only team to win all the games so far. It would be a cherry on the cake for them if they make it three wins in a row by knocking out their arch rivals Australia.

Welcome everyone to the 10th match of the ICC Champions Trophy, 2017 between England and Australia at Edgbaston, Birmingham. It's the last match of Group A and a must win for the Aussies. If they lose or even if this match is another washout like their previous two games, Bangladesh will be going through to the semis. They have no choice but to bring out their A-game today and they are a team which strives under pressure situations.
